headline: Executive order lets federal agencies hire certain military spouses for civil service jobs without the usual competitive process.
what_it_does: This order allows federal agencies to hire spouses of certain members of the Armed Forces into civil service jobs without the normal competitive hiring process. The title does not say which service members' spouses qualify or what limits apply. No summary was provided, so the details are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses of certain members of the Armed Forces
who_it_affects.how: They may be hired into federal civil service jobs without going through the regular competitive process.
They gain the option to fill some jobs by directly appointing eligible military spouses.

who_it_affects.group: Other applicants for federal civil service jobs
who_it_affects.how: Some positions may be filled through these noncompetitive appointments instead of open competition.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 25, 2008; the title does not state a separate start date.
